results.title: My Account Dropdown (7 Core Paths With Hierarchy) & On-Site Order Tracking (6 Details + Cancellation Requested State)
results.vision_reasoning: Hybrid DOM & geometry heuristic probe verified full compliance.
results.remediation_guide: Structure the Account dropdown with all 7 core self-service paths (highlighting 'Orders' and 'Returns' at the top), ingest carrier webhooks to render all 6 tracking details natively on-site, and add `CANCELLATION_REQUESTED` to your order state machine.

results.title: Credit Card Input Auto-Formatting in 4-Digit Space-Separated Chunks (Baymard Checkout)
results.remediation_guide: Use `<input type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="cc-number" maxlength="23" placeholder="0000 0000 0000 0000" />` (never `type="number"`) and format live input with `val.replace(/\D/g, '').replace(/(\d{4})(?=\d)/g, '$1 ')`.

results.title: Stored Payment 'Fake Editing Flow' Without Forcing Card Deletion First
results.vision_reasoning: UI pattern not present in page DOM (3-state HAX logic: DOES_NOT_APPLY).
results.remediation_guide: Render an `'Edit'` button on every saved payment card. When the user submits updated details, create a new payment token via your gateway and subsequently call `DELETE /payment-methods/:oldTokenId`.

results.title: Applied Filters Overview Bar & Support for 8 Core Search Query Types
results.vision_reasoning: Hybrid DOM & geometry heuristic probe verified full compliance.
results.remediation_guide: Render `<AppliedFiltersBar filters={activeFilters} onRemove={...} onClearAll={...} />` above the results grid, and configure hybrid search indexing to parse attributes, compatibility models, price modifiers, and typo-tolerant synonyms.

results.title: Avoid Horizontal Tabs for Core Product Page (PDP) Content Sections
results.vision_reasoning: UI pattern not present in page DOM (3-state HAX logic: DOES_NOT_APPLY).
results.remediation_guide: Replace horizontal `<Tabs>` on Product Detail Pages with vertically stacked `<section id='specs'>` and `<section id='reviews'>` blocks paired with a sticky anchor jump-bar (`position: sticky; top: 64px;`).

results.title: Always Signpost Hidden Thumbnails in Product Image Galleries
results.vision_reasoning: UI pattern not present in page DOM (3-state HAX logic: DOES_NOT_APPLY).
results.remediation_guide: Overlay a `+4 more` badge on the final visible thumbnail in desktop strips, or set `grid-auto-columns: 82%` on mobile carousels so the leading edge of the next image peeks into view.

results.title: Actionable Empty States With Clear Explanation & Primary CTA (IBM Carbon)
results.vision_reasoning: UI pattern not present in page DOM (3-state HAX logic: DOES_NOT_APPLY).
results.remediation_guide: Implement a structured `<EmptyState title='No matching items found' description='Try adjusting or clearing your active filters' action={<Button>Reset Filters</Button>} />` for all lists, tables, and dashboard widgets.

results.title: Progressive Skeleton Loading States Instead of Blocking Spinners (IBM Carbon)
results.vision_reasoning: Hybrid DOM & geometry heuristic probe verified full compliance.
results.remediation_guide: Replace generic spinning loaders with structural `<SkeletonPlaceholder />` components matching the exact dimensions (`width`/`height`) of the target content, and set `aria-busy="true"` on the loading region.

results.title: Read-Only vs Disabled State Differentiation & Responsive Overflow Menus (IBM Carbon)
results.remediation_guide: Use `readonly` instead of `disabled` for non-editable reference values that users need to read or copy (such as Order IDs, API tokens, or emails) with >= 4.5:1 contrast. Collapse secondary toolbar actions into `<OverflowMenu aria-label='More actions'>`.

results.title: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS < 0.1) — Visual Layout Stability
results.remediation_guide: Declare explicit `width` and `height` attributes (or `aspect-ratio: 16 / 9`) on all `` and `

results.title: Interaction to Next Paint (INP <= 200ms) — Main-Thread Responsiveness
results.remediation_guide: Yield long event handlers using `scheduler.yield()` or `setTimeout(..., 0)`, wrap non-urgent UI updates in React `startTransition`, and keep total DOM size below `1500` nodes.

results.title: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP <= 2500ms) Across Mobile & Desktop
results.remediation_guide: Add `fetchpriority="high"` and remove `loading="lazy"` on the primary above-the-fold LCP image, serve AVIF/WebP formats, preload critical hero assets via `<link rel="preload" as="image">`, and keep server TTFB `< 600ms`.

results.title: Visible Streaming Progress & Mandatory Human-in-the-Loop Approval for Consequential Actions
results.vision_reasoning: UI pattern not present in page DOM (3-state HAX logic: DOES_NOT_APPLY).
results.remediation_guide: Stream tokens via SSE/WebSockets with `<ReasoningSteps steps={...} />` (`aria-live='polite'`) and gate all side-effecting tool calls behind an explicit `<ActionApprovalCard diff={proposedChanges} onConfirm={...} onCancel={...} />` dialog.

results.title: Upfront AI Capability & Precision Disclosure (Microsoft HAX G1 & G2)
results.vision_reasoning: UI pattern not present in page DOM (3-state HAX logic: DOES_NOT_APPLY).
results.remediation_guide: Render 3–4 clickable starter prompt chips above the AI input ('Compare pricing tiers', 'Summarize report') and a persistent disclaimer below the composer: `'AI responses may contain inaccuracies. Please verify critical financial or legal facts.'`

results.title: Cautious Adaptation — Forbid Live List & Menu Reshuffling While Reading (Microsoft HAX G14)
results.remediation_guide: Buffer asynchronous ranking updates in background state and display a non-intrusive `<Button>Show 3 new recommendations</Button>` pill banner instead of mutating live DOM order under the user's cursor.

results.title: Granular Feedback (HAX G15), Non-Destructive Refinement & Explicit Context/Memory Reset
results.vision_reasoning: UI pattern not present in page DOM (3-state HAX logic: DOES_NOT_APPLY).
results.remediation_guide: Attach `<AiActionToolbar onRate={...} onRegenerate={...} onEditBranch={...} />` below every AI response and provide a `'Reset Context / New Session'` control in the assistant header.

results.title: Liquid Glass & Translucent Surface Contrast Safety (>= 4.5:1)
results.vision_reasoning: Hybrid DOM & geometry heuristic probe verified full compliance.
results.remediation_guide: Always pair `backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%)` with a protective semi-opaque surface tint (`background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78)` in light mode and `rgba(24, 24, 28, 0.82)` in dark mode) plus a subtle `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)` border.

results.title: Liquid Glass & Motion Adaptation for prefers-reduced-transparency & prefers-reduced-motion
results.remediation_guide: Add global CSS media queries: `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }` and `@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) { .glass-surface { backdrop-filter: none !important; background-color: var(--surface-solid) !important; } }`.

results.title: Minimum Touch Target Size of 44x44pt (Apple HIG Ergonomic Floor)
results.remediation_guide: Set `min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;` on all buttons, toolbar icons, and mobile navigation items.

results.title: Body Typography Legibility Floor >= 17pt/px (Apple HIG)
results.remediation_guide: Set primary body copy to `font-size: 1.0625rem` (`17px`) with `line-height: 1.5`, and ensure all `<input>`, `<select>`, and `<textarea>` elements use at least `16px` (`1rem`) to prevent unintended iOS auto-zoom.

results.title: Dynamic Type Scaling Up to 200% Without Text Clipping
results.remediation_guide: Define all typographic scales and spacing tokens in `rem`, avoid `white-space: nowrap` on buttons and card titles, and use `flex-wrap: wrap` so horizontal layouts stack vertically at large text sizes.

results.title: ISO 9241-110:2020 Dialogue Principles — Task Suitability, Controllability & Error Robustness
results.vision_reasoning: Hybrid DOM & geometry heuristic probe verified full compliance.
results.remediation_guide: Remove non-essential fields from conversion forms (Suitability for the task), provide explicit 'Back / Cancel' actions at every dialog step (Controllability), and display inline format examples prior to validation errors (Use error robustness).

results.title: 48x48dp Touch Target & >= 8px Inter-Target Spacing Gap (Material Design 3)
results.remediation_guide: Apply `gap: 8px` (or `0.5rem` / `12px`) on all flex/grid containers holding button groups, filter chips, or action bars, and size primary touch controls at `min-height: 48px`.

results.title: Calibrated Trust: Clickable Source Citations, Categorical Confidence Cues & HAX G11 Security Exception
results.vision_reasoning: UI pattern not present in page DOM (3-state HAX logic: DOES_NOT_APPLY).
results.remediation_guide: Render interactive `<CitationChip href={source.url} title={source.title} />` badges alongside AI claims, use 3-tier categorical confidence labels (`High / Medium / Verify independently`), and abstract internal anti-abuse triggers behind safe high-level notices.

results.title: Doherty Threshold — UI Visual Feedback Under 400ms
results.remediation_guide: Implement Optimistic UI for fast mutations (likes, add-to-cart, tab switches), transition button states to `loading` within `< 50ms` via `useOptimistic`, and offload heavy computations from the main thread.

results.title: Gestalt Proximity & Common Region — Label-to-Input Distance < 50% of Inter-Field Gap
results.remediation_guide: Wrap each `label + input + helper-text` unit in a `.form-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }` container, and space sibling field groups via `.form-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }`.

results.title: Miller's Law (5–9 Top-Level Nav Items) & 4-Digit Alphanumeric Chunking
results.remediation_guide: If top-level navigation exceeds 7–9 links, consolidate secondary destinations into categorized mega-menus or drawers. Format long numeric strings using `Intl.NumberFormat` and 4-digit regex grouping.

results.title: Postel's Law — Liberal Input Acceptance & Programmatic Normalization
results.remediation_guide: Remove restrictive HTML attributes such as `pattern="^[0-9]{10}$"` and tight `maxlength` caps that truncate pasted spaces. Normalize input values in code before validation (`const cleanValue = rawValue.replace(/[\s\-()]/g, '');`) and format display masks automatically.

results.title: Serial Position Effect & Zeigarnik / Goal-Gradient Progress Indicators
results.vision_reasoning: Hybrid DOM & geometry heuristic probe verified full compliance.
results.remediation_guide: Anchor primary entry points and conversion CTAs at the far-left and far-right edges of headers and bottom tab bars. In multi-step flows, render `<ol aria-label='Checkout steps'>` with `aria-current='step'` and a visual completion bar.

results.title: Von Restorff Isolation Effect — Single Visually Dominant Primary CTA per Viewport/Card
results.vision_reasoning: Hybrid DOM & geometry heuristic probe verified full compliance.
results.remediation_guide: Structure buttons across three explicit hierarchy tiers: `Primary` (solid accent fill `bg-primary text-on-primary` — max 1 per screen/dialog), `Secondary` (`border-outline bg-transparent`), and `Tertiary` (`bg-transparent text-muted`).

results.title: Reflow at 320 CSS px Without Horizontal Scrolling
results.remediation_guide: Replace fixed pixel widths (`width: 400px`) with fluid sizing (`width: 100%; max-width: 400px`), use `flex-wrap: wrap`, `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 280px), 1fr))`, and apply `overflow-wrap: break-word` to long headings and URLs.

results.title: Text Spacing Resilience (1.5x Line, 2x Paragraph, 0.12em Letter, 0.16em Word)
results.remediation_guide: Avoid fixed heights with hidden overflow on text containers and buttons (`height: 36px; overflow: hidden`). Use `min-height: 44px; height: auto; padding-block: 0.5rem;` and relative `rem`/`em` units.

results.title: Contrast Minimum (>= 4.5:1 Normal Text, >= 3.0:1 Large Text & UI Components)
results.remediation_guide: Use semantic design tokens verified for WCAG 2.2 AA compliance (at least `#595959` on `#FFFFFF` white background for body/secondary text and `#767676` minimum for input borders and icons).

results.title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) — Sticky Header & Footer Protection
results.remediation_guide: Set `scroll-padding-top` and `scroll-padding-bottom` on the root scroll container (`html`) equal to the height of fixed/sticky toolbars (e.g., `html { scroll-padding-top: 80px; scroll-padding-bottom: 64px; }`) so the browser automatically scrolls focused controls clear of fixed overlays during Tab navigation.

results.title: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced) — Zero Overlap of Focused Component
results.remediation_guide: Apply generous `scroll-margin-block` on interactive elements accounting for `outline-offset` (e.g., `:focus-visible { scroll-margin-block: 96px; }`) and ensure any non-modal floating banners can be dismissed with the `Escape` key.

results.title: Focus Appearance — Minimum 2px Perimeter & >= 3.0:1 Contrast Change
results.remediation_guide: Never apply `outline: none` without a high-contrast replacement. Use a dual-ring focus indicator: `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005FCC; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #FFFFFF; }`, guaranteeing >= 3.0:1 contrast over any light or dark surface.

results.title: Dragging Movements — Single-Pointer Alternative Required
results.vision_reasoning: Hybrid DOM & geometry heuristic probe verified full compliance.
results.remediation_guide: Pair all `input[type='range']` and custom sliders with linked `<input type='number'>` fields or step increment buttons (`-` / `+`). For drag-and-drop cards and sortable lists, provide a single-click action menu ('Move up / Move down / Move to column...').

results.title: Target Size (Minimum) — 24x24 CSS Pixels Floor
results.remediation_guide: Enforce `min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px;` on all interactive targets (`44px` recommended per Apple HIG / `48px` per Material 3). If the visual icon is smaller (`16x16px`), expand its hit area using `padding` or `::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8px; }`.

results.title: Consistent Help — Predictable DOM & Visual Placement
results.remediation_guide: Place the Help/Support link or chat widget inside a shared global `<header>` or `<footer>` layout component in a fixed DOM position so its `Tab` order remains consistent across page transitions and zoom levels up to 200%.

results.title: Redundant Entry — Auto-Populate or Reuse Session Data
results.remediation_guide: Persist form state in `sessionStorage` or your state store across wizard steps, default the `'Billing address same as shipping'` checkbox to checked, and bind standard HTML `autocomplete` tokens (`name`, `email`, `tel`, `shipping street-address`).

results.title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum) — Allow Paste, Autocomplete & Passkeys
results.remediation_guide: Remove any `onpaste="return false"` or `e.preventDefault()` paste listeners on password and OTP inputs. Set `autocomplete="username webauthn"` and `autocomplete="current-password"`, add a password visibility toggle button, and support WebAuthn/Passkeys.

results.title: Accessible Authentication (Enhanced) — No Object-Recognition CAPTCHA Puzzles
results.vision_reasoning: Hybrid DOM & geometry heuristic probe verified full compliance.
results.remediation_guide: Replace interactive visual CAPTCHA puzzles with cryptographic device attestation (Private Access Tokens, WebAuthn Passkeys) or passive server-side risk scoring.

results.title: WCAG 3.0 Draft Maturity Scoring (Bronze, Silver, Gold & Holistic Task Flows)
results.remediation_guide: Eliminate all `CRITICAL_LEGAL_EAA_ADA` violations to reach the baseline `BRONZE` tier, implement user-preference media queries (`prefers-reduced-motion`, `prefers-contrast`, `prefers-color-scheme`) for `SILVER`, and validate end-to-end keyboard/screen-reader task flows for `GOLD`.
